scope: bounded primary-source audit of complete nonlinear J/E for KMS-symmetric qubit QMS

items.claim: A universal positive C for complete J >= C E on all KMS-symmetric qubit QMS is established by the checked primary sources.
items.reason: The exact complete C=4 prior found applies under GNS/sigma_Tr-DBC. KT's p=1 weak and strong endpoints are conjectural and system-only. The LWW complete MLSI counterexample concerns J versus relative entropy, not E.
items.decisive_gate: A source theorem with arbitrary KMS symmetry, all finite untouched references and faithful joint states, and the physical J versus KMS-root E functional pair.
